subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Infrastructure Shapes Trade
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Infrastructure Shapes Trade.

hook.text: Civilizations that built roads, ports, and canals thrived. Those that didn't were left behind.

buildup.text: From Roman roads to the Panama Canal to fiber-optic cables, infrastructure is the backbone of trade.

discovery.text: Good infrastructure lowers transport costs, enabling goods to reach more markets at better prices.

twist.text: Infrastructure takes decades to build and billions to fund. Neglect it, and trade slowly strangles.

climax.text: China's Belt and Road Initiative invests $1 trillion in global infrastructure. Control the roads, control trade.

punchline.text: Build the road and commerce follows.

quiz.question: Why does infrastructure matter for supply chains?
options: It lowers transport costs and enables trade
